name: The Hunza Valley Explorer
summary: Seven relaxed days among apricot orchards, old forts and mountain views in Hunza.
description: Start in Karimabad and walk up to the old Baltit Fort. Take a boat across Attabad Lake, meet local families over tea, and watch the peaks change colour at sunset. Slow days, short walks and plenty of time for photos.

startLocation.description: Meeting point in the old town below Baltit Fort

locations.description: Old town walk and Baltit Fort
Village walk and orchards in Gulmit
The high pass on the border with China

name: Skardu and the Shangrila Lakes
summary: Lakes, sand dunes and the Shigar valley around Skardu, with an easy walk every day.
description: Stay near Lower Kachura Lake, explore the cold desert dunes near Skardu and visit the old fort at Shigar. Each day has an easy to moderate walk, and the evenings are for tea and stargazing.

locations.description: Shigar valley and its old fort

name: Fairy Meadows and Nanga Parbat View
summary: A short, steep trek to green meadows facing the huge face of Nanga Parbat.
description: Drive on a rough jeep track, then walk uphill to Fairy Meadows and stay in a camp or hut. If the weather is clear, the mountain is in front of you all day. The walk is steep and needs good fitness and proper shoes.

startLocation.description: Meeting point in Chilas, before the drive towards Fairy Meadows

locations.description: Night in Chilas before the climb
Nanga Parbat itself, seen from the meadows

name: Swat Valley and Kalam Retreat
summary: Green hills, rivers and mountain villages in Swat, ending in the cool upper valley of Kalam.
description: Drive through the Swat valley with stops at riverside villages and old markets. In Kalam we take forest walks and visit a mountain lake if the road is open. A gentle trip for families and first-time travellers.

startLocation.description: Meeting point in Mingora, the main town of Swat

locations.description: The cool upper valley with river and pine forests

name: Neelum Valley Riverside Escape
summary: Riverside stays and forest walks in the Neelum Valley of Azad Kashmir.
description: Follow the Neelum river upstream, with stops at small towns and viewpoints along the way. We sleep close to the water, walk through pine forest and spend one day in a high village. The pace is slow and the views are long.

startLocation.description: Meeting point in the capital, where the Neelum meets the Jhelum

locations.description: Riverside village high in the Neelum Valley

name: Deosai Plains High Camp
summary: Camp on the high Deosai plateau, one of the highest plains in the world, far from any city.
description: Drive up from Skardu to the open plateau and camp under a huge sky. Days are for walking across the grass and, in summer, the wild flowers. It is cold and high, so the nights are chilly and the trip needs good health and warm clothes.

startLocation.description: Meeting point in Skardu before the drive up to the plateau

locations.description: Last supplies and rest in Skardu
Camp near Sheosar Lake on the plateau
